not_observed: No comparator page states that it flags contradictions between OCDS free text and structured fields or gives a canonical hash of the checked release; absence on marketing pages is not evidence the feature is absent.
hypotheses: Text-vs-structured-field discrepancy flagging is a narrow real gap (observed twice: welfare 6-year text vs 2031 maxExtentDate; Croydon status). Whether any supplier pays for it is unevidenced.

verdict_reason: The CAD 49 per-notice brief has no remaining distinct paid deliverable: the same checks are now free in our own preview, and the nearest incumbent gives free AI bid/no-bid reports and alerts. Its only unique element (discrepancy flagging with hashes) is narrow and its willingness-to-pay is unevidenced. Stop treating per-notice reconciliation as the revenue hypothesis; do not build further tender inventory or tools for it.
